creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-1. Move keymap, input pipeline, composition arbiter, frame decoding, diagnostics and the herdr adapter to Rust, with the conformance corpus as the acceptance criterion rather than a reading of the Swift tests.

Sequenced deliberately: port what already works and is covered before writing anything new on top, so a wrong seam surfaces on code we trust. herdr's src/ghostty/mod.rs is a working reference for driving libghostty-vt's key encoder from Rust, which is the fiddliest part.

Blocked on the corpus extraction (a_27HFEWM52) landing first.
title: Port the core to Rust, against the corpus
